answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can vote or claim emission. Stake size scales with recent network activity at the onboarding wharf, so a flood of fake IDs burns capital. After a cool-down meadow of several epochs with clean peer attestations, the stake unlocks; failed or spam identities forfeit it. Attackers pay real opportunity cost per sybil, while honest agents recycle capital.
